phase: Phase 19 — Fix Frontend LocalStorage Quota Error and Remove Large Scheme Data Persistence

rootCauseAnalysis.issue: Setting the value of 'schemebridge_schemes' exceeded the quota (DOMException / QuotaExceededError)
rootCauseAnalysis.cause: AppContext.jsx was persisting all 4,734 schemes (~10-15 MB JSON) into browser localStorage upon app load, exceeding the ~5 MB browser quota and causing uncaught exception on login / initial page load.
rootCauseAnalysis.resolution: Removed full catalog serialization to localStorage. Implemented safe storage wrapper, automatic migration to purge legacy oversized keys, and preserved small metadata only.

changesApplied.summary: Added safeSetItem, safeGetItem, safeRemoveItem with QuotaExceededError safety, and cleanupLegacySchemeCache() idempotent migration.
Removed localStorage.setItem('schemebridge_schemes'), integrated safeStorage for all small state, and invoked legacy cache cleanup on mount.
Called cleanupLegacySchemeCache() before createRoot to sanitize storage prior to component rendering.
Protected document vault state persistence with safeStorage.
Protected notification state persistence with safeStorage.
Replaced direct localStorage calls with safeGetItem and safeSetItem.
Protected MFA state and user profile storage with safeStorage.
Protected calculator prefill state with safeStorage.
Used safeRemoveItem for cleanup of onboarding prefill data.
Created 9 dedicated unit & integration tests for quota resilience, migration, and scheme resolution.
